data.title: How Much Does a Bitcoin ATM Charge You to Buy $100 of Bitcoin?
data.description: One reporter fed a crypto kiosk a $20 bill and walked away with far less Bitcoin than expected. Before you hand cash to one of these machines, see which hidden charges take the biggest bite and what cheaper routes exist.
